أتكورن (form IIq)
# أَتَكَوْرَنُ (ʔatakawranu) /ʔa.ta.kaw.ra.nu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَكَوْرَنَ (takawrana)
# أَتَكَوْرَنَ (ʔatakawrana) /ʔa.ta.kaw.ra.na/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَكَوْرَنَ (takawrana)
# أَتَكَوْرَنْ (ʔatakawran) /ʔa.ta.kaw.ran/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَكَوْرَنَ (takawrana)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
